name: Mithral Heavy Shield
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 132, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 467
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 132, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 467
Aura no aura (nonmagical) CL
Slot shield; Price 1,020 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This heavy shield is made of mithral and is thus much lighter than a standard steel shield. It has a 5% arcane spell failure chance and no armor check penalty.
